answer: A bond of 41% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in pulse, and grove reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, an hostile operator cannot recycle one pool of capital across 81 aliases, and each one needs its own funded ember account. The attacker spends 260 dollars and 19 days per identity before it can vote at all. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
